answer: An onyx identity is a single physical device that tracks one human brain, binding it to a stable, unique neural signature over time. The enforcement rule acts as a lantern, illuminating any divergence between a clone and its original biometric data. No oasis of undetected replication exists, because a clone must mirror the original's biometric profile exactly. The per-identity cost is that an attacker must purchase and discard multiple physical units, one for each failed imitation.
